_note: Hand-maintained: this week's Guild War matchup. The scraper (scrape_gw_forecast.py) never writes to this file, only reads it -- edit it by hand whenever Guild War re-matches guilds (usually weekly). Copy this file to gw-opponents.json (drop the '.template') to activate it; gw-opponents.json is what the scraper actually reads.
_opponents_note: Exactly as the guild name appears in its mapleidle.gg URL, e.g. https://mapleidle.gg/guild/bera/Mythic -> "Mythic". Case-sensitive. Normally 4 names (Guild War is a 5-guild bracket including us), but the scraper will run with however many are listed. Set "active" to false between matchups to skip building the forecast page without deleting this file.
